title: 第九十六章  赌马
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“少爷，您尝尝这个，这是刚出炉的桂花糖藕，可甜了。”

苏莹用竹签挑起一块，小心翼翼地递到顾淮嘴边。

顾淮也不客气，张口咬下，细细品味了一番，笑着点了点头。

“软糯香甜，确实不错。”

两人正闲逛着，前方不远处的一片空旷草场上，突然传来了一阵排山倒海般的欢呼声和急促的马蹄声。

“好！威远侯府的白凤果然神勇，这一局我赢了！”

“该死，那绝影怎么在最后关头软了脚，害得本公子白白输了五百两银子！”

一阵阵充斥着铜臭与亢奋的叫喊声此起彼伏，瞬间吸引了顾淮的注意力。

“少爷，那边好像围了好多人，好像是在赌马呢。”

苏莹踮起脚尖，有些好奇地往那边张望着。

“走，咱们也过去凑个热闹，看看这些京城里的纨绔子弟平日里都是怎么消遣的。”

顾淮合拢折扇，带着苏莹迈步朝那片草场走去。

走得近了，才发现这里已经被围得水泄不通，外围停满了各色华丽的马车，场中则是一条用木栏围出来的环形跑道。

数十个衣着华贵、神色狂热的世家子弟正聚在庄家面前，挥舞着手中的银票，声嘶力竭地呐喊着。

“买定离手，买定离手啊。”

“下一场，太仆寺少卿家的踏雪，对阵安国公府的追风。”

“各位公子爷可瞧准了下注！”

庄家扯着嗓子大喊，面前的木桌上堆满了白花花的银子和一叠叠厚厚的银票。

顾淮看着这热闹的场景，一时间也有些手痒，转头对苏莹笑了笑。

“小莹，拿张银票出来，少爷今天也来试试手气。”

苏莹没有任何犹豫，立刻从怀里摸出一张五十两的银票递了过去。

顾淮随手将银票押在了那匹看起来骨骼极粗、但毛色有些杂乱的“追风”身上。

随着一声刺耳的锣响，两匹骏马如同离弦之箭般窜了出去，在跑道上疯狂地飞奔。

围观的权贵子弟们瞬间爆发出震耳欲聋的喝彩声，一个个面红赤耳，恨不得自己上去替马跑。

只可惜顾淮这一局的运气似乎不怎么样，那匹“追风”在半途便被拉开了距离，最终输掉了比赛。

“少爷，咱们输了。”

苏莹有些心疼地看着那张被庄家收走的银票。

“无妨，胜败乃兵家常事，图个乐呵罢了。”

顾淮洒脱一笑，脸上不见丝毫恼怒之色。

“这次听你的，你觉得哪匹马能赢，咱们就押哪匹。”

苏莹仔细地在场中观察了一番，指着一匹通体雪白、极为神骏的白马说道：

“少爷，我觉得那匹白马好看，跑得肯定快，咱们押它吧。”

“好，便听我家小莹的，押一百两，买这匹白马赢。”

顾淮再次摸出一张银票，随手扔在了桌上。

Page (1/3)

"Master, please try this. It's freshly baked sweet-scented osmanthus and lotus root. It's so sweet."

Su Ying picked up a piece with a bamboo skewer and carefully handed it to Gu Huai's mouth.

Gu Huai was not polite, he opened his mouth to bite it, tasted it carefully, and nodded with a smile.

“It’s soft, glutinous and sweet, really good.”

The two were wandering around when, in an open grassland not far ahead, there was suddenly an overwhelming cheer and the sound of rapid horse hooves.

"Okay! Bai Feng from Weiyuan Hou Mansion is really brave. I win this round!"

"Damn it, why did Jueying give in at the last moment, causing me to lose five hundred taels of silver!"

Waves of shouts filled with the smell of copper and excitement came one after another, instantly attracting Gu Huai's attention.

"Master, there seems to be a lot of people gathered over there. They seem to be betting on horse racing."

Su Ying stood on tiptoes and looked over there curiously.

"Come on, let's go over and join in the fun and see how these dandy boys in the capital spend their time."

Gu Huai closed the folding fan and walked towards the pasture with Su Ying.

As I got closer, I realized that the place was completely surrounded. There were all kinds of gorgeous carriages parked on the outside, and in the middle was a circular track surrounded by wooden fences.

Dozens of richly dressed and enthusiastic-looking young men from aristocratic families were gathering in front of the banker, waving the banknotes in their hands and shouting at the top of their lungs.

"If you buy it, leave it. If you buy it, leave it."

"In the next match, Ta Xue from Taipusi Shaoqing's family will face off against Zhui Feng from Duke Anguo's family."

"Young masters, be sure to place your bets!"

The dealer shouted at the top of his lungs. The wooden table in front of him was piled with white silver and thick stacks of silver notes.

Looking at this lively scene, Gu Huai's hands felt a little itchy for a moment, and he turned to Su Ying and smiled.

"Xiaoying, come out with a banknote. The young master is here to try your luck today."

Without any hesitation, Su Ying immediately took out a fifty-tael silver note from her arms and handed it over.

Gu Huai casually placed his banknote on the horse "Zhui Feng", which looked extremely thick-boned but had a messy coat.

With the piercing sound of the gong, the two horses rushed out like arrows from the string, galloping wildly on the track.

The onlookers of the nobles and nobles burst out into deafening cheers instantly, all of them blushing and wishing they could go up and run for the horse.

Unfortunately, Gu Huai's luck didn't seem to be very good in this game. The horse "Chasing the Wind" was pulled away midway and eventually lost the game.

"Master, we lost."

Su Ying looked at the banknote that was taken away by the banker with some distress.

"It doesn't matter. Victory and defeat are common matters for military strategists. It's just a matter of fun."

Gu Huai smiled freely, without any trace of anger on his face.

"It's up to you this time. We'll bet on which horse you think can win."

Su Ying observed the scene carefully, pointed to a white horse that was all white and extremely elegant, and said:

"Master, I think that white horse looks good and can run fast. Let's keep it."

"Okay, just listen to my Xiaoying and bet a hundred taels on this white horse to win."

Gu Huai took out a banknote again and threw it on the table.
